Attached: 1 image

Last week's IncusOS post listed Proxmox, XCP-ng and ESXi and skipped the hypervisor we have run and installed since 2007: KVM, in the Linux kernel since 2.6.20, on Ubuntu. Proxmox and Incus both run their VMs on it, so the choice is a management layer. New post: why Ubuntu plus KVM is our default, why we skip libvirt and talk to QEMU directly, and eVirt, our YAML-per-machine framework. https://blog.eracks.com/2026/09/kvm-on-ubuntu-since-2007/ #KVM #Ubuntu #Linux #SelfHosted
